Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Jones
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 01/13/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 33 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Examiners of Public Accounts by an undetermined amount to conduct audits or examinations of certain nonprofit water service providers. However, any increase in obligations could be offset, wholly or partly, by reasonable fees charged by the Department as authorized by the provisions of this bill.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs
